# pbs_prune_job (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing PBS prune job configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the prune job.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this prune job.
- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file the object is stored in (shared by all objects in that file; informational only).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this prune job is disabled.
- `keep_daily` (Number) Keep daily backups for the last N days.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Keep hourly backups for the last N hours.
- `keep_last` (Number) Keep the last N backup snapshots.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Keep monthly backups for the last N months.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Keep weekly backups for the last N weeks.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Keep yearly backups for the last N years.
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum depth for namespace traversal.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace filter as a regular expression.
- `schedule` (String) When the prune job runs (systemd calendar event format).
- `store` (String) The datastore name where pruning is performed.
